subject: Using r/qtl2 for a mulriple parent  BCsFt  population

messages.author: 64f7ba4010416aa7
messages.subject: Using r/qtl2 for a mulriple parent  BCsFt  population
parts:
Hi,

I recently used r/qtl for mapping in a  population consisting of  BC2S3 lines from crosses of 10 diversity donors with a single reference parent. 
I reduced the genotypes to reference and nonreference and followed the "Users Guide for New BCsFt Tools for R/qtl" 

I want to know if I can use r/qtl2 in this kind of population? Is this population a kind of ail? 
Could I bring the genotype probabilities calculated in rqtl to rqtl2 and then use the linear mixed model mapping?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Using r/qtl2 for a mulriple parent  BCsFt  population
parts:
I don’t think there is a cross type in qtl2 that would be appropriate, at present.
You can try converting the genotype probabilities using the probs_qtl_to_qtl2() function in the qtl2convert package, https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2convert

karl
